_comment: PAPER ONLY. Same as lean.example.json but with the L10 execution model ON: every BUY/SELL is re-quoted exec_delay_s later (BUY fills at the worse of q0/q1, SELL at q1) and fees include priority fee + Jito tip per transaction, ATA rent (paid on the first buy, refunded on a full close) and the Token-2022 transfer fee. Money values are in SOL. exec_delay_s must be <= price_ttl_seconds - 2. Absent or null = today's instant fills.
